## What broke

Describe the observed behavior.

## Reproduction

List the smallest steps or fixture that reproduces it.

## Expected behavior

State the contract the repository should enforce.

## Evidence

Paste validator output or link to the exact file and line. Remove credentials, customer data, and private product names.

## Environment

Include the operating system and `python --version` output when the validator is involved.
